native_retrieval.title: Narendra Modi’s Sharad Pawar praise lands state BJP in a tight spot | Pune News - The Times of India
native_retrieval.snippet: PUNE: With Prime Minister Narendra Modi publicly admiring Sharad Pawar’s role as his political mentor, BJP leaders in the state, including chief minister Devendra Fadnavis, are in a tight spot.While the state BJP cadre is pressurising the government to launch an offensive against Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) leaders accused of being involved in irrigation and other scams, the chief minister and his colleagues in cabinet are confused with Modi and senior leaders, like Nitin Gadkari, rubbing shoulders with Pawar and showering praises on him. However, a section of BJP leaders look at the bonhomie as an effort by the PM to keep Pawar on his side at a time when the entire opposition is joining hands against him ahead of the winter session in the parliament. Adding to BJP workers’ woes, on Monday Gadkari was in Manjari to attend the sugar conference and shared the dais with Pawar.BJP sources said that the PM’s admiration for Pawar is because he was the only UPA minister who cooperated Modi after the Gujarat riots even as other ministers at the Centre boycotted Modi when he was Gujarat chief minister.
